'''Rajabi''' was a [[Dragonsworn]] leader originally from [[Arad Doman]]. He was an officer under [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Appearance ==
He had a bull-neck. He had brown eyes, a wide nose and a bulbous chin. He was completely bald and resembled a boulder. He later lost a leg to battle and replaced it with a peg.

== Activities ==
He met with Ituralde and the other Dragonsworn leaders, in Arad Doman under the [[White Ribbon]]. They agreed to attack the [[Seanchan]] together on the [[Almoth Plain]]s.

He was with Ituralde's force when they destroy the Seanchan force outside [[Darluna]]. He was also with Ituralde when they decide to make their last stand in an [[Ogier]] ''[[stedding]]'' in Arad Doman. While there, they were visited by [[Dragon|The Dragon Reborn]] who offers them a way out by serving him instead.

He is part of Ituralde's force that is sent to [[Maradon]] to engage [[Shadowspawn]]. He lost his leg in the fighting but refused to leave the battle. He leads a group of men who recover the wounded during a lull in the fighting. He was later killed by a [[Draghkar]] who was pretending to be a dead body thrown into the camp by Shadowspawn trebuchets.
